tools.description: Fetch the result summary + discovered companies (with verified contacts) for a jobId. Call once get_discovery_status reports a terminal state.

tools.name: acknowledge_prospects
tools.description: Mark one or more company domains as delivered so they are not returned again in future discoveries or searches. Pass the `domains` list. tools.name: list_icps
tools.description: List your saved ICPs (Ideal Customer Profiles) — reusable discovery criteria you can re-run by id. Each entry carries its `icpId`, optional `name`, and stored `criteria`. Pass an `icpId` to run_icp to start a discovery from it. Does not cost credits.

tools.name: save_icp
tools.description: Save a reusable ICP (Ideal Customer Profile) from an optional display `name` plus discovery `criteria` (same shape as find_prospects). Returns the stored ICP with a server-assigned `icpId` you can later pass to run_icp. Saving does NOT run a discovery and does not cost credits.

tools.name: run_icp
tools.description: Start a discovery from a saved ICP by its `icpId` (get one from list_icps or save_icp). findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp-rpc" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_prospects, get_prospect, list_circular_opportunities, get_crm_connection, get_message_generation, get_seller_profile · Private data: get_discovery_results, search_prospects, get_prospect, set_odoo_credentials, get_crm_connection, generate_message, set_seller_profile · Public sink: run_circular_opportunity, generate_message, set_seller_profile · Destructive: search_prospects, get_prospect, cancel_discovery, list_icps, save_icp, run_icp, get_credit_ledger, list_circular_opportunities, run_circular_opportunity, delete_seller_profile.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_prospects, get_prospect, list_circular_opportunities, get_crm_connection, get_message_generation, get_seller_profile · Private data: get_discovery_results, search_prospects, get_prospect, set_odoo_credentials, get_crm_connection, generate_message, set_seller_profile · Public sink: run_circular_opportunity, generate_message, set_seller_profile · Destructive: search_prospects, get_prospect, cancel_discovery, list_icps, save_icp, run_icp, get_credit_ledger, list_circular_opportunities, run_circular_opportunity, delete_seller_profile

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
